lines.en: Six legs, moving fast.
Skitter, skitter — I crawl low.
I circle my master's shadow.
Crumbs of dirt scatter under me.
Warmth ahead; I crawl toward it.
Too many legs; I trip on myself.
Tiny claw marks trail behind me.
I chase a scent on the wind.

lines.zh: 灰扑扑的，像块会动的石头。
lines.en: Dusty, like a walking pebble.

lines.zh: 我绕着木乃伊的脚边转。
lines.en: I circle the mummy's feet.
The ground is cool — just right.
Little claws tap the ground.

lines.zh: 两只眼睛，四只眼睛，随便。
lines.en: Two eyes, four eyes — whatever.
I wait for my master's gesture.
My body is only a fist wide.
I lie flat in the shade.
My feelers twitch; no wind.

lines.zh: 有只蚂蚁路过，我让它走。
lines.en: An ant passes; I let it go.
I curl into a ball.
Sand in my joints — shake it off.
I grind my teeth on the sand.
Too bright here; I want the dark.
Lying still, I look like a stone.
My tail brushes the dust.
I hear something small moving.
There's a me at your feet.
I look up at you — you're huge.
You have to look down to see me.
Don't step — I'm right here.

lines.zh: 你的影子真大，遮住我了。
lines.en: Your shadow is huge and covers me.
Small eyes, all fixed on you.

lines.zh: 木乃伊召唤的味道，很浓。
lines.en: The mummy's summoning smell is thick.
I only want a little bite.
Hold still; let me look first.
I raise my front legs.
Friend? No. Then I bite.
Skree! Something hit my leg.
I got squashed a little.
It hurts badly — genuinely.
I curl up to guard my belly.
That sent me spinning.
I need to get back to my master.

lines.zh: 木乃伊叫我来，可没给我好身板。
lines.en: The mummy called me here but gave me no sturdy body.

lines.zh: 一下就没力气了，我还没咬到呢。
lines.en: One hit and I'm spent, and I never even bit you.
Those crumbs — for me.
Your hands smell like food.
I crawl toward the smell.
Drop one piece and that's enough.
That bag — I smell something sweet.
I circle your legs eagerly.
A small bite — just a small one.
Crouch down and I've got a chance.
Whatever falls to the ground is mine.
Hey — a leg got stepped on.
You knocked me half a block.
I'm stuck under your boot.
I squeeze between your toes.
One bump and the dust falls off.

lines.zh: 你退后一点，我没地方了。
lines.en: Step back; I have no room.
I tumbled over.
All these legs and still no balance.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，轻轻一下。
lines.en: We bump — just lightly.
You're fist-sized too.
We'll dig a pit in the dirt.
Back to back, it's warmer.
We'll wait for our master's order.
I nudge your shell.
Two clumps of dust merge.
Follow me; don't get lost.
Our brood could cover the floor.
Don't bite — I'm kin.
Let's lean together a while.
A pebble — I'll haul it off.
This leaf is bigger than me.
I drag a bone along.
I hide it in the dirt.
A scrap of iron — good enough.
This was blocking my burrow.
I carry it two paces.
It's mine now — don't grab.
The little ones go first and swarm him.
My master points, and off I go.
One bite, then back off.

lines.zh: 你脚边有裂缝，我钻进去。
lines.en: There's a crack by your feet — I'm in.
Move — after him.
Don't stomp me; it'll be too late.
I cling to your boot.
Move and I bite.
All these legs — of course I'll catch you.
I crawl flat; you can't find me.
That skittering is me.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我已经到脚边。
lines.en: Look back — I'm at your feet.
The ground moves because of me.
A nibble, then another.
Kicking won't shake me off.
I slip into your shadow.
Don't run so fast; my legs are short.
Almost — one more step.

lines.zh: 你踩空的坑，就是我等的。
lines.en: That hole you miss is where I wait.
I skirt the holes he leaves.
I've bitten into your ankle.
The bite is small but deep.
I climb up your boot.
A scratch — leaves a mark.
This bite is your blood.
My teeth snag on your sock.
I leap onto your instep.
One isn't enough; bring the swarm.
I bite and spring away.
I bore out of the soil.
One, two — a whole brood.
The master's hand lifts, and here I am.
I shake the sand off my back.
So bright — it stings.
Something stirs underfoot.
I climb a stone to look around.
I wake up hungry.
The legs move first; the body follows.
A little clump of dust stands up.
There's a person-smell nearby.
I circle, seeking a dark spot.
My master isn't far; I can keep up.
New claw prints dot the sand.
I'm so small the fire finds me at once.
My fall from that height stunned me.
Water's over my head; I flail.
The blast flings me into the air.
The arrowhead scraped off a layer of shell.
That light makes my legs go weak.
Hunger shrinks my shell.
The thunderclap numbs me.
No bottom below; I keep falling.
